newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - San Jose, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to section 53692 of the California Government Code and section 33646 of the

California Health and Safety Code, that the Redevelopment Agency of the City of San Jose (the Agency'') intends to sell, at public sale, not to exceed $115,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its Merged Area Redevelopment Project Tax Allocation Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds''). Bids will be received at 10:00 a.m., California time, on

at the offices of Nossaman, Guthner, Knox & Elliott, LLP, 50 California Street, 34th Floor, San Francisco, California 94111, and the Bonds will be awarded by the Executive Director of the Agency or his designee (pursuant to

authorization of the Agency Board) within 26 hours after the expiration of the time prescribed for the receipt of the bids, except that if no bid acceptable to the Agency is submitted at such time or if the sale is postponed in accordance with the Notice of Sale pertaining to the Bonds, bids shall be received on such succeeding day as shall be set forth in a notice given by Munifacts News Service not later than 24 hours prior to the time then scheduled for the receipt of such bids. The Agency reserves the right to postpone or cancel the sale provided that notice of such change is given by Munifacts News Service not later than 2:30 p.m., California time, on the business day prior to the time then scheduled for the receipt of such bids. The Notice of Sale and Preliminary Official Statement pertaining to the Bonds may be obtained from Tom Lockard of Stone & Youngberg LLC, 50 California Street, 35th Floor, San Francisco, California 94111, telephone: (415) 981-1314; e-mail:
Redevelopment Agency of the City of San Jose
